versions.content: Structuring according Variants The meta-class Access- CountSet should be used to group the AccessCount . value s which are valid for one particular variant of the software. The grouping might be used if the AccessCount . value s are evaluated by code parsing since the parsing might be done for a specific variant of the C-implementation.
